newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to head for 4,785 then 4,800.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to head for 4,785 then 4,800.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index should end the week in robust form on Friday and it will be a measure of investor confidence plus a fear of being left behind which will send the index hurtling to a new intraday peak, technical analysts said.
The blue chip index is expected to push up towards 4,800 with an intermediate stopping stage at 4,785, they said.
Share rises will be across the board but banks, insurance and utilities should benefit from lower bond yields and the likelihood of stable earnings will drive pharmaceuticals higher.
The FTSE 100 was indicated up 9.4 to 4,766.8 by 0711 GMT.

The FTSE had strayed a little in mid-week but the scintillating performance on Wall Street on Thursday -- when the Dow Industrials average bolted up 135.64 points to 7,711.47 -- should mean the FTSE will try to match some of that lead.
The London stock market had hinted at its strength on Thursday when it nearly overlapped the previous day's trading range on a daily bar chart.

But the tearaway Dow is now the catalyst for a rip roaring session in London although there may be some caution prior to the announcement of U.S. producer prices for May due out at 1230 GMT, analysts said.

Economists forecast producer prices to have increased 0.1 percent in May. A small number will confirm the view that there are no inflationary pressures building up in the U.S. and that the Federal Reserve will not have to raise interest rates in July.
But if producer prices data are stronger than expected, stock markets will take a dive, analysts said.
